patch_description: The current program has only 0–4% valid samples before repair, so many QAOA samples are spending effort on degree-infeasible networks. Increase the evaluator-supplied degree penalty from 5 to 15 to make the exact two-in/two-out constraints more influential relative to the normalized surrogate costs. This does not add any degree terms to the returned QUBO and stays within the allowed penalty-weight range.
